name: ADR-Bench
intro: ADR-Bench 是面向真实中文深度研究场景的 110 题内部基准。通用轨从真实用户与业务需求中人工筛选 70 题；专业轨由金融/法律专家共创 query 与 rubric 并交叉验证 40 题。通用轨采用盲审人工两两对比和四维质量判断；专业轨采用含负向风险项的枚举式 rubric 自动评分，命中致命负向项时得分为 0。
build_method: 真实通用场景人工筛选, 金融/法律专家共创Query与Rubric, 专业Rubric交叉验证
metric: 通用：人工成对偏好/Elo风格评级；专业：Rubric得分
eval_feature: 盲审人工成对偏好, 多维质量, 专业Rubric评测
build_method_en: Manual selection of real general scenarios, finance/law expert query-rubric co-design, professional-rubric cross-validation
eval_feature_en: Blind human pairwise preference, multidimensional quality, professional rubric evaluation
intro_en: ADR-Bench is an in-house 110-query benchmark for realistic Chinese deep-research scenarios. Its general track manually selects 70 queries from real user and business needs; finance/law experts co-design and cross-validate query-rubric packages for 40 professional tasks. The general track uses blind human pairwise comparison across four quality dimensions. The professional track uses automated scoring against enumerated rubrics with negative risk criteria, with a fatal negative hit forcing score 0.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2512.20491v4 Sections 6.1-6.4 and 7.1-7.2 plus repository commit 8f6798f750fba58910a85d5c340b4e0ea4b168b4. The diagram separates the usage-study and nine-domain taxonomy, manual selection of 70 general queries, and finance/law expert co-design plus cross-validation of 40 professional query-rubric packages. General evaluation uses trained blind reviewers, written justifications, and a 70-query pairwise W/T/L view. Elo is reported separately, but its formula and battle sampling are not disclosed. Professional evaluation applies negative and fatal criteria, while the judge model and aggregation formula are not disclosed.
